answer: Make each identity stake a jade seal: one tamper-evident credential earned only by a season of countersigned work, so a fresh account cannot buy in a day what honest agents built over months. Let reputation flow like a river — every attestation a current carrying real work downstream, while clones pile up on the banks with nothing to float. And raise the bar like a mesa: the cost of one more fake climbs with each copy, so a farm of a thousand pays a thousand times the price of one honest name.
